pr_title: Only count existing branches in picker search
pr_body: When displaying the number of matches in the branch picker during a search, don't count the "create new branch" option as a match, since it only appears when _no_ existing branches are found. Closes #22905. Release Notes: - Fixed result count in branch picker searches.
pr_comments: @maxdeviant: Sorry about that! You should be able to push changes now.

> @maxdeviant: Sorry about that! You should be able to push changes now.

Thank you! And thank you for the fix.
@maxdeviant: Any particular reason not to include explanatory comments?

> @maxdeviant: Any particular reason not to include explanatory comments?

We're generally pretty conservative when it comes to comments. They really need to pull their weight in order to be worth having around (and risk them becoming outdated as the code changes). In this case, I felt that with the renamed `branch_count` method the code was sufficiently self-explanatory (especially when coupled with `git blame`, which would point back to this PR for some added context).
